label: Peninsula counter (mini-bar)

stretch.how: extend the run; stools space out to suit, one per 0.60 m

clearance.reason: stool pulled out, plus room to pass behind it
working at the counter from the kitchen side

notes: The most common divider in the precedent set — 26 of 79 records separate kitchen from dining or living with a counter and stools and NOTHING else, and PH vendor plans often label it MINI-BAR outright. Footprint is the counter; the stools are drawn beyond it because that is where they are, which shows the real cost: 0.60 m of counter but about 1.65 m of floor. One end normally meets the kitchen counter or a wall — it is a peninsula, not an island. At 0.60 m deep there is no knee room, so this is a perch: use counter_dining_divider where the counter has to serve as the dining table.
